$comment: Authored (WP-F). D-001 rebinds and deliberate deviations from the Tecton export / tecton-astryx values. Every entry names palette paths (or a literal for non-colour tokens) and carries a reason. `pnpm tokens:check` fails on unknown tokens, unknown palette paths and missing reasons.

overrides.reason: D-001 accent ink. The export binds this role to action.primary.adornment (violet.onLight.140 #dbcae1), the adornment ON the dark primary fill: 1.42:1 as ink on the light page. Rebound to the ink role tecton-astryx used (lilac.onLight.830 #5c3878, 8.4:1). Dark keeps the export value (lilac.onDark.830, identical in tecton-astryx).
D-001 accent ink. Same as --color-text-accent: the export's action.primary.adornment is 1.42:1 as an icon colour on the light page.

Contrast fix. The export's status.error.bright is red.onLight.370 (#ed371d); Toast (the only consumer) puts the on-dark ink (#f6f5f8) on it: 3.9:1. Rebound to red.onLight.680 (#a3240d, the export's own error fill), 7.6:1. Dark keeps the export value (red.onDark.830 with the on-light ink).

overrides.value: "Figtree Variable", Figtree, "Figtree Fallback", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
overrides.reason: D-003. Fontsource's variable package registers the family as "Figtree Variable"; "Figtree" covers a locally installed copy; "Figtree Fallback" is the Capsize metric-matched local(Arial) face from fonts.css.

overrides.value: "Figtree Variable", Figtree, "Figtree Fallback", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
overrides.reason: D-003. Headings differ from body by weight only (tecton-astryx).

overrides.value: "IBM Plex Mono", "IBM Plex Mono Fallback", Consolas, Monaco, monospace
overrides.reason: D-003. "IBM Plex Mono Fallback" is the Capsize metric-matched local(Courier New) face from fonts.css.

allowedExtraNames.name: --button-focus-offset
allowedExtraNames.reason: Documented upstream Button property (Button.doc.mjs theming.vars, default var(--focus-outline-offset)); Tecton sets 1px. Not one of the 258 tokens, so it is listed here.

allowedExtraNames.name: --font-size-adjust-body
allowedExtraNames.reason: A§5.4: numeric font-size-adjust for body text (Figtree x-height ratio). Pipeline-defined, provisional.

allowedExtraNames.name: --font-size-adjust-code
allowedExtraNames.reason: A§5.4: numeric font-size-adjust for code (IBM Plex Mono x-height ratio). Pipeline-defined, provisional.
